list.title: Campaigns
list.emptyExplanation: A campaign is one email sent to a group of contacts. Pick the audience, write the message and see who received it.
list.loadErrorReason: The request did not finish. The data is not lost, only the listing failed.

audience.recipientCount: {count, plural, =0 {No recipients} one {# recipient} other {# recipients}}
audience.onlySample: The audience contains only sample contacts. They will not receive anything.
audience.hasSample: The audience contains sample contacts. They will be skipped.

send.confirmUndo: You will have {seconds} seconds to cancel. After that the emails can't be taken back.
send.blockingTitle: This has to be fixed first

preflight.campaignAudienceEmpty: The audience is empty. Pick at least one list or segment.
preflight.campaignNotCompiled: The template has not been compiled yet.
preflight.campaignNoUnsubscribe: The template has no unsubscribe link. The campaign can't be sent without it.
preflight.campaignUnknownMergeField: The template uses fields that don't exist: {fields}.
preflight.campaignAudienceTooLarge: The audience has more than {max} recipients. Split the campaign.
preflight.campaignAudienceOnlySample: The audience contains only sample contacts. They will not receive anything.
preflight.campaignAudienceHasSample: The audience contains sample contacts. They will be skipped.
preflight.campaignSenderMissing: The campaign has no sending account or no sender domain.
preflight.providerQuotaExceeded: You're sending {count} messages but only {remaining} remain in today's Amazon limit. Split the campaign or wait until the limit resets.
preflight.providerSandbox: Your Amazon account is still in test mode. You can send at most 200 messages per day, only to verified addresses.
preflight.providerNotReady: The sending account is not ready.
preflight.providerSendingPaused: Amazon has paused sending on this account.
preflight.domainDkimMissing: Domain {domain} has no verified DKIM signature. Without it your emails will land in spam.
preflight.domainSpfMissing: The SPF record is missing or does not authorize Amazon.
preflight.domainDmarcMissing: The domain has no DMARC record. Gmail and Yahoo require it from bulk senders.
preflight.deliverabilityComplaintBlocking: Sending is blocked because of spam complaints. Your rate is {rate}.
preflight.deliverabilityDegraded: Your complaint rate is {rate}, which is close to the limit.
preflight.deliverabilityBounceWarning: Your bounce rate is {rate} over the last 30 days.
preflight.campaignTrialMode: Trial mode is on. Of {audience} selected recipients only {verified} verified addresses will receive the email.
preflight.contractMismatch: The links stored with this campaign don't match the compiled template. Click tracking would not work, so we stopped the send.

pauseReason.renderFailureRate: The template is failing to render for a large share of recipients. We stopped the campaign until it's fixed.
pauseReason.credentialsUndecryptable: We couldn't decrypt the sending account credentials. A key rotation is probably in progress.
pauseReason.providerQuotaExhausted: You've used up today's Amazon limit. The campaign will resume automatically once the limit resets.
pauseReason.providerUnavailable: The sending service is not responding. The campaign is on hold while we retry.
pauseReason.bounceGuard: We paused the campaign ourselves. The bounce rate puts your sending account at risk.
pauseReason.complaintGuard: We paused the campaign ourselves. The complaint rate puts your sending account at risk.
pauseReason.providerBlocked: Amazon has blocked sending on this account.
pauseReason.materializeTimeout: Preparing the audience took too long. Resume to continue where we left off.

progress.title: Sending progress
progress.sentHint: Handed over to the mail server. This does not mean it reached the inbox.
progress.deliveredHint: The recipient's server accepted the message. Confirmations arrive with a delay, so this number will still grow.
progress.bouncedHint: The recipient's server rejected the message. We have removed these addresses.
progress.ambiguousHint: We are not sure whether these messages were handed over. You can resend them.
progress.stopped: Stopped. {sent} of {total} sent, those can't be recalled.
progress.claimedNote: Messages already handed to the sending process will still go out. That is at most one batch.
progress.stalled: Sending is stalled. Check that the sending process is running.
progress.loadError: We couldn't load the progress, we keep trying.

dns.recordCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to add} one {Add # record} other {Add # records}}
dns.title: DNS records for {domain}
dns.waiting: We don't see it yet. Changes usually show up within 15 minutes.
dns.wrongValue: The record exists but has a different value.
dns.nameDuplicated: It looks like the name was entered together with the domain. We found {found}. Change the name to {expected}.
dns.cloudflareProxy: The record is proxied through Cloudflare (orange cloud). DKIM needs it turned off, switch it to DNS only.
dns.unknown: We couldn't reach the DNS server. We'll try again in a minute.
dns.spfMultiple: You have two SPF records. Mail servers ignore both in that case. Merge them into one.
dns.propagation: DNS changes usually show up within 15 minutes, rarely it takes up to 24 hours. You can close this page, we keep checking and will let you know.
dns.guideStale: We haven't verified this guide for a while, the provider's panel may look different. Follow the record values, not the button names.
dns.delegate: Send to whoever manages our website

trial.banner: Trial mode: of {audience} selected recipients the email will go {verified, plural, =0 {to nobody, you have 0 verified addresses} one {to only # verified address} other {to only # verified addresses}}.
trial.disable: The domain is verified. Turn off trial mode
trial.title: Trial mode
trial.explanation: Verifying a domain waits for DNS propagation, which takes minutes to hours. In trial mode you can send right away, but only to addresses you verify here.
trial.addressesEmpty: No address here yet. Without a verified address nothing goes out in trial mode.
trial.limitReached: Trial mode allows at most {max} verified addresses.
trial.dialogExplanation: We'll send a link to the address. It becomes verified only once somebody opens that link.
trial.sent: We sent a confirmation link to {email}.
trial.devLink: Email sending is not wired up yet, so outside production the link is also here: {url}
trial.verifyDoneDetail: Campaigns in trial mode will now reach {email}.
trial.verifyFailedDetail: The link is broken, expired, or the address is no longer on the list. Add it again in sending settings.

deliverability.title: Deliverability
deliverability.empty: Once you send your first campaign you'll see how your emails are delivered here.
deliverability.estimateNote: Our number is an estimate. The binding value is the one in the Amazon console.
deliverability.bounceHint: Amazon puts you under review at 5 %. Clean the database with the Never opened preset.

sending.title: Sending
sending.providersEmptyExplanation: A sending account is where your emails physically go out from. Amazon SES for volume, plain SMTP for a few hundred a day.

addDialog.title: New sending account
addDialog.explanation: A sending account is where your emails physically go out from. We store the credentials encrypted and the list only ever shows them masked.
addDialog.typeSesHint: For volume. Handles tens of thousands of messages a day and reports bounces and complaints back.
addDialog.typeSmtpHint: For a few hundred a day. All you need is a server, a username and a password from your provider.
addDialog.name: Account name
addDialog.nameHint: Only so you can tell accounts apart. Recipients never see it.
addDialog.regionHint: In the eu-central-1 format. It has to match the region where your domain is verified.
addDialog.configurationSetHint: Leave it empty and we will create our own.
addDialog.tooLong: Must not be longer than {max} characters.
addDialog.failed: We could not create the account.

sending.domainsEmptyExplanation: The domain in your From address has to authorize us to send on its behalf. That is what the DNS records are for.

thresholds.title: Deliverability guards
thresholds.explanation: These numbers stop a campaign before Amazon does. The value from the installation is both the default and the ceiling, so you can only make a guard stricter, never looser.
thresholds.bounceGuard: Pause at a bounce rate of
thresholds.complaintGuard: Pause at a complaint rate of
thresholds.bounceWarn: Warn at a bounce rate of
thresholds.complaintWarn: Warn at a complaint rate of
thresholds.minSent: Evaluate only after this many messages
thresholds.tooLoose: You can only set a stricter value. The ceiling is {max}.

smtpWarning: A plain SMTP server can't report undelivered mail and complaints to us. You have to maintain the blocked address list yourself.
